svg.title: Final score review checklist
svg.desc: Before sharing, verify tuning, rhythms and bar lengths, note spelling and articulations, track balance, and page breaks.
svg.text: BEFORE YOU SHARE · A QUICK SCORE CHECK

g.text: Instrument, tuning, capo, and notation view are correct.
Every bar has the intended beats; rests and ties are clear.
Fret positions and playing effects match the musical idea.
Page breaks, track labels, and playback balance are readable.
